prompt: Stage 3-2 gold augment, 84 HP, 44 gold, level 6. You already run four units of a vertical, two of them 2-star, and your scout shows nobody else holding its units. The Crest offered is for that trait. Which augment?

lobby.note: Different vertical, no overlap with yours

explanation:
Run the framework in order. Fit: you already have four units of the trait and the Crest adds an emblem plus a fifth unit, so the next breakpoint is reached the moment you take it, no rolling required. Econ plan: it costs nothing and it does not change your 4-1 level timing. Floor or ceiling: at 84 HP you can afford a ceiling-raiser, and this one also raises the floor because the breakpoint bonus applies now. Contest: two scouted players are on other lines. Every question comes back yes; this is the case where the trait augment is correct and taking a safe generic augment instead would be the leak.

Windfall is fine but replaceable by one good round of interest. Backline Tempo helps a 1-star carry a little. Neither changes what your board is; the Crest turns a loose collection into a committed vertical with a free emblem that lets you put the trait on a 4-cost later.
principle: Trait augments are excellent when you already own the units and nobody else does; the framework says yes, so say yes.
commonMistake: Over-learning "trait augments are traps" and passing on one that the board has already paid for.
